newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec. 12.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec. 12.

text.p: All of Mexico's major ports were open Thursday as of 1500 local/2100 GMT, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Clear skies with strongest winds from northeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves as high as three to five feet.

Cold front heading southwest expected to bring lower temperatures and isolated rains to the region in the next 24 hours. Winds from the south at 10 to 15 knots, causing wave heights between three and five feet.
Wind gusts and rains headed to Honduras, Nicaragua and Belize coasts. East and northeast winds at speeds of 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
